title: Improved stable influence bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. For real numbers $\eta,\tau>0$, if the Boolean influence of $f$ at $i$ is less than $\tau$, then its stable influence at parameter $\eta/(2+\eta)$, applied to the real-valued version of $f$, is at most $\tau^{1/(1+\eta)}$ times the Boolean influence of $f$ at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean influence of $f$ at $i$ is less than $\tau$
